Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000055": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000733" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder, having transferred from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000686" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched from the ledger service to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000795": As of 2025-11-06, Marcus has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000713" [preference]: As of 2025-09-30, the Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000768": On 2025-11-03, the Boreal team reported that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000811": As of 2025-11-17, Farah has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000547": On 2025-07-30, Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000476": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000390": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000011": As of 2025-01-07, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, the bus, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Cinder, ledger service, indexer, reporting service, Lena, Marcus, webhook dispatcher, notification service, billing API, Farah, Dune team, notifier, INC-2025-004, Oskar, job scheduler, Ember team

[2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
